ExecutiveSummary.Overview: MFA was enabled or DISABLED for an account. Triage: legitimate MFA administration, or an attacker disabling MFA to maintain access / weaken an account?
ExecutiveSummary.BusinessImpact: Disabling MFA removes a critical control - attackers do it to keep access to a compromised account or to ease future logins.

Assets.AssetType: Exchange Online, SharePoint/OneDrive, Teams, Entra directory

TelemetryRequirements.Requirement: O365 unified audit via Elastic Agent (verified live). Fields: event.action, user.name, source.ip, o365.audit.Operation, o365.audit.ResultStatus, o365.audit.ObjectId, o365.audit.ModifiedProperties, o365.audit.Parameters, o365.audit.UserId. INGEST LAG 20-60 min - all queries use a 4h window and timestamp_override event.ingested at rule level.
JCB egress NAT is 94.249.88.0/24 - internal users appear from it.

Signal.Name: Office 365 - MFA Enable/Disable
Signal.Details: o365.audit event.action event.action LIKE "*StrongAuthentication*" OR event.action LIKE "*MFA*" OR o365.audit.Operation LIKE "*StrongAuthentication*".

InitialAssessment.Rule: Weigh the full evidence story per the ClassificationGuidance, not any single fact.

Investigation.Goal: Determine whether this Entra/Exchange/SharePoint change is authorised administration or unauthorised/abuse.

Step.name: Confirm the operation, actor and result
Step.Purpose: Identify exactly what changed, who did it (user.name), from where (source.ip), and the result.
Step.Query: FROM logs-o365.audit-* | WHERE event.dataset == "o365.audit" AND (event.action LIKE "*StrongAuthentication*" OR event.action LIKE "*MFA*" OR o365.audit.Operation LIKE "*StrongAuthentication*") AND @timestamp >= NOW() - 4 hours | KEEP @timestamp, event.action, user.name, source.ip, o365.audit.ObjectId, o365.audit.ResultStatus | SORT @timestamp DESC | LIMIT 25
Step.AnalystNotes: Confirm the actor, target object and result. An unfamiliar actor, an external/unusual source, or a change with no ticket is the concern.

Step.name: The actor's broader admin activity in the window
Step.Purpose: A burst of privileged changes by one actor indicates scripted abuse or a compromised admin session.
Step.Query: FROM logs-o365.audit-* | WHERE event.dataset == "o365.audit" AND user.name == "$username" AND @timestamp >= NOW() - 4 hours | STATS operations = COUNT(*), actions = VALUES(event.action), sources = VALUES(source.ip) | LIMIT 1
Step.AnalystNotes: Several privileged changes by one actor in minutes indicate scripted abuse or a compromised admin session.

Node.Condition: MFA DISABLED for an account by an unfamiliar actor, or self-disabled after a suspicious login.
A recognised admin performing the change under an approved ticket/window.
A conditional-access change unintentionally affecting MFA.
Actor plausibly delegated but no change record.

DocumentationChecklist.Item: Attach outputs of INV-01-O365-EVENT, INV-02-O365-ACTOR to the case.

FalsePositive.Definition: Legitimate MFA administration (enrolment, reset) by an identity admin.

SOCAction.Item: Verify the change ticket/owner; close as false_positive.

TruePositive.Definition: An attacker disabling MFA to preserve access.

Indicators.Item: MFA disabled by an unfamiliar actor.

SOCAction.Item: Reverse the change; revoke sessions/tokens for the actor and affected principals; open IR.
Review the actor's other audit activity.

Misconfiguration.Definition: A misconfigured CA/identity policy toggling MFA.

Indicators.Item: A conditional-access change unintentionally affecting MFA.

Phase.name: Immediate Actions (0-30 minutes)
Phase.Action: Confirm the change/actor in the audit log.
If unexpected/unauthorised, disable the actor session and reverse the change.

Phase.name: Containment and Eradication (hours)
Phase.Action: Reverse the change; revoke sessions/tokens for the actor and affected principals.
Review the actor's other recent audit activity.

Phase.name: Recovery and Hardening (days)
Phase.Action: Enforce MFA/conditional access; tighten admin consent and privileged-role governance (PIM); alert on these operations.

QualityChecks.Check: Account for O365 ingest lag (20-60 min) - short windows miss events; this rule uses event.ingested override.
Exclude the egress NAT 94.249.88.0/24 where source is used; tune known admin/automation via exceptions.

TruePositiveClosure.Item: MFA re-enabled; account reset + tokens revoked; actor investigated.
